name: code-desk
description: Set a project's starting conditions and run the work through them: interview the owner into a written quality contract, build and red-prove the one gate command that enforces it, then keep the release loop honest — the review findings a green check hides, recurring status comms and authored presentations with portable PptxGenJS packages, existing-deck editing and rendered verification, READMEs backed by live screenshots, and the project-memory taxonomy. The in-repo _meta planning system that used to ship here now lives in the mise-en-place plugin.
